name: maradocs
description: MaraDocs — a Docker-first publishing system that lets agents ship static HTML reports through a CLI or REST API, then return durable URLs with controlled access.

scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter ./packages/shared build && pnpm -r --filter ./packages/cli --filter ./packages/skill --filter ./apps/server build && pnpm --filter ./apps/dashboard build
scripts.build:server: pnpm --filter @maradocs/shared build && pnpm --filter @maradocs/dashboard build && pnpm --filter @maradocs/server build
scripts.clean: pnpm -r exec rm -rf dist node_modules .turbo && rm -rf node_modules
